lanes.summary: The diff perfectly implements the requested automated approval flow for the signer bot. It cleanly adds `pr_review_approve_signer_runs.sh` as a step to the `pr-review-sign` job to approve the specific `pull_request` runs that get held under the fork-approval policy. The script explicitly ensures that only `github-actions[bot]` runs matching the exact pushed SHA and marked as `action_required` are touched. The `--self-test` harness is exceptionally well-written, mocking the GitHub API to validate the 8 edge-case rows and 4 failure mutants exactly as requested by the ticket (4/4 RED). The script also correctly exits non-zero if the API refuses approval or if no run appears within the wait window. No external dependencies, secrets, or `.github/workflows` modifications were introduced.

lanes.summary:
The diff satisfies all four acceptance criteria of PMAT-4579 and I found no refutation.

**AC1 (filter correctness):** `select_held` (line 48–58) filters on exactly `head_sha==sha`, `event==pull_request`, `actor.login==github-actions[bot]`, `conclusion==action_required`. The step runs only when `env.signed_any == '1'` (after the push) and passes `$(git rev-parse HEAD)` — the just-pushed sha. No other run is touched.

**AC2 (self-test: 8/8 rows, 4/4 mutants, wired):** `run_rows()` has exactly 8 `row` calls (lines 130–144). Four planted mutants (no-sha, no-event, no-actor, no-held) each disable one filter and are verified killed. The self-test step is wired in `ci/sections.yml` at line 2748–2750 in the `pr-review-sign` job.

**AC3 (failures exit non-zero):** Approve failure returns 1 with the run URL in the error message (line 78). No-run-at-all returns 3 (line 94). Both tested in rows 7–8 of the self-test.

**AC4 (no secret, ruleset, or .github/workflows change):** Confirmed: the three changed files are `ci/sections.yml`, `docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml`, and `scripts/pr_review_approve_signer_runs.sh`. None are in `.github/workflows/`. The token used is `${{ github.token }}` (the job token), not a secret. No ruleset files changed.
